request.style: English, female solo voice with ethereal choir, piano, strings, harp, soft drums, majestic and triumphant mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The trumpet sounds in a blink of an eye
The dead rise up to live eternally
This perishable puts on what is immortal
The mortal body is changed by the call

[Chorus]
Where O death is your victory
Where O death is your sting
The sting of death is sin
But God gives us the victory

[Verse]
Thanks be to God for the win
Through our Lord Jesus Christ we begin
Be steadfast and immovable stand
Always abounding in the Lord's hand

[Chorus]
Where O death is your victory
Where O death is your sting
The sting of death is sin
But God gives us the victory

[Bridge]
Labor in the Lord is not vain
Hope remains for us in the rain
The law held power over sin
But Christ has broken the chain

[Chorus]
Where O death is your victory
Where O death is your sting
The sting of death is sin
But God gives us the victory

[Outro]
Death has been swallowed up
Victory is ours to keep
